title.en: Ancient Chinese Science: Quakes, Stars & Numbers
title.zh: 古代科技：地震、星空与数学

clips.send: Zhang Heng built the seismoscope in 132, in the Eastern Han. When an earthquake happened, the dragon facing that direction dropped its bronze ball into a toad’s mouth. It detected quakes; it could not predict them.
clips.text: Zhang Heng built the seismoscope in 132, in the Eastern Han. When an earthquake happened, the dragon facing that direction dropped its bronze ball into a toad’s mouth. It detected quakes; it could not predict them.

clips.send: 东汉张衡在 132 年制成地动仪。地震发生时，朝着那个方向的龙会把铜球吐进蟾蜍嘴里。它能检测地震的方向，不能预报地震。
